plan.notes: Source: official 'Associate of Arts in Teaching (AAT) Program Pathway' PDF, hosted on lonestar.edu (departments/curriculuminstruction/AAT Degree Plan.pdf). Verified 2026-10-06. Meets Generalist, Bilingual and ESL certifications for EC-6 and 4-8. Footnotes: (1) MATH 1314 is a prerequisite or placement by testing for MATH 1350/1351; (2) 32 hours of observation required (16 in EDUC 1301, 16 in EDUC 2301) with background check; elective option lists are the PDF's transfer recommendations — students should verify transfer-institution requirements.

courses.title: Public Speaking or Interpersonal Communication Choice
